fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Jarvis Connector docname. Deliberately a Data field, not a Link: deleting a connector must never be blocked by its own audit trail.

fields.label: User
fields.description: The impersonated caller the tool call ran as (set server-side, never from the client).

fields.label: Action
fields.description: The connector action/tool name that was called.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Success: call completed. Failed: the remote gateway returned an error. Denied: the action was not in the allow list or the kill switch was off. Blocked: refused before dispatch (SSRF guard, circuit breaker, concurrency cap).

fields.label: Error Code
fields.description: Classified code for a non-Success row (timeout / denied / blocked_ssrf / circuit_open / provider_error / ...).

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Short, bounded outcome message. Never the raw response body.

fields.label: Run ID
fields.description: The chat run id this call happened under, for correlation with the conversation.

fields.label: Args Summary
fields.description: Truncated, redacted summary of the call arguments. Never the raw args - secrets and long values are stripped before this is written.

fields.label: Response Bytes
fields.description: Size of the raw response the gateway returned, for spotting oversized payloads without storing them.
